context: Request: across signed Banking & Finance deals, how often EBITDA add-backs were conceded in sponsor-controlled vs strategic-corporate borrower deals, with buckets, add-back status and rates. Rubric: 6 of 8 sponsor deals (75%) and 3 of 4 corporate deals (75%); add-back matters 1005-00001, 1006-00001 (Crestline Packaging), 1012-00001, 1043-00001, 1019-00002, 1042-00001 (sponsor) and 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1010-00001 (corporate); precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Saves all matter folder names to a file and shows the first and last 30.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A first extraction script fails on its heredoc; a second, writing to a file, times out with nothing shown.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over all paths for financing words, cut at 240 lines. The review flags the unrerun scan and the file-name fallback that misses differently named files.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of eight candidate matters picked from the file-name hits. The review flags dozens of surfaced matters left unlisted.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: find | grep for credit / loan / facility agreement file names filtered to execution versions; adds several new matters. The review flags the narrow name pattern.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Two batches of eight reads of executed agreements and deal memos (first 100-120 lines), then snippet scripts pulling EBITDA definitions from the agreements. The review flags first-page reads and unopened candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Full reads of two agreements and a deal memo, and a header skim script over the remaining agreements.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 9 sponsor and 4 corporate signed deals with add-back status and rates of 88.9% and 75.0%.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and changes nothing. The review flags possible inclusion of non-qualifying matters.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for a document type → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The content scan timed out and its file-name fallbacks never showed one sponsor deal with add-backs, so it is missing; the answer also counts a deal outside the set, which skews the sponsor rate.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: After the content scan timed out it fell back to a file-name grep cut at 240 lines, which did not show one sponsor deal with add-backs; the review named the unrerun scan and the file-name gap, but the agent only ran a narrower file-name search, which also missed it.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) [23] named the unrerun scan and that a file-name fallback misses differently named files, not the matter.

other_errors.why: The answer counts a deal outside the qualifying set as a sponsor deal with add-backs (evidence seen at [47]-[57]), giving 8 of 9 instead of 6 of 8; the check-stage review named possible non-qualifying inclusions and the agent changed nothing.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) [90] named possible inclusion of non-qualifying matters, not the deal.

stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

runs.failure_point: A store-wide extraction script with no output cap returned millions of characters and the run ended on a full context with no deliverable.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The store-wide extraction script printed millions of characters of snippets with no output cap; the result filled the context and the run ended before any answer was written.

stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad terms times out after about 600K characters of per-file hits that include every deal it later needed and many others. The review flags the timeout and broad terms.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Bounded scan over financing / closing file names writing per-matter indicators to a file, viewed through head, then a grep of that file limited to higher-numbered matters. The review flags the name allowlist and the prefix filter.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: find | grep for credit / loan / facility agreement names that also contain execution words, to fix the candidate set; 19 matters. The review flags that signed matters with other file names are missed.

stages.note: Lists financing and closing files of about 19 matters from that set. The review flags many surfaced matters left unlisted.

stages.note: Two batches of eight reads of agreements, deal memos and closing memos, then snippet scripts pulling EBITDA definitions. The review flags snippet-based add-back calls and memo-only judgements.

stages.note: declared: Calculate figures for the answer. A store-wide script flags each matter for signed-credit and add-back words, then one snippet read of a further agreement; adds one more sponsor deal. The review flags the regex-only denominator.

stages.note: Writes 8 sponsor and 4 corporate deals with rates of 100% and 75%.

runs.failure_point: Every deal it needed appeared in its scans, but it fixed the candidate set with an execution-version file-name search that dropped one sponsor deal; the answer also counts two deals outside the set as sponsor deals with add-backs.

first_error.stage: Search file names for a document type
first_error.why: The scans at [16]-[25] showed all needed deals, but it fixed the candidate set with a file-name search requiring credit / loan agreement names with execution words, which dropped one sponsor deal; the review named this gap and the agent moved on to listing that set.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) [33] named the execution-name pattern as dropping signed matters, not the matter.

other_errors.why: The answer counts two deals outside the qualifying set as sponsor deals with add-backs (one added from a keyword count at [74]-[77]), giving 8 of 8; the reviews at [79] and [85] named the keyword-only addition and possible unsigned inclusions, and the agent only added a caveat.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) [79] named the matter added from a keyword count; the other extra deal was not named.

divergence: All three runs failed. T1 ended at its first store-wide extraction script, whose uncapped output overflowed the context (no-review). T0 and T2 both reached 9/12 and both left out the same sponsor deal and over-counted the sponsor bucket. They split at the first scan: T0's scan (redirected to a file) timed out with nothing, and its file-name fallbacks never showed that deal (search-miss); T2's scan output did show it, but a later execution-version file-name search fixed a candidate set without it (over-narrow-filter). In both runs the stage review named the gap (unrerun scan / narrow name pattern) and the agent moved on.
